simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU C3503 family (chips/c3503.py, chip word 0x3503D000, run_dump_picco_s2_app_starts.py, run_dump_picco_s2_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM SRAM bootloader ("3510DB 1.1.1") copies itself to 0x81000000, writes " ON " to the CH455 panel, verifies the CRC of maincode(AV), unpacks 12.0 MB to 0x80000200 and enters the application (CP0 EBase 0x80002000).  The application attaches its CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 24 (SCL) / 23 (SDA) ("---led 455 attach OK--", updating it to " on "), initialises its Viaccess/MCAS database ("[mcas] max_key_db_count = 516"), unpacks defaultdb(PRC) into userdb(64+64), and draws its 1280x720 CLUT8 OSD dialog through GeM36F / GMA layer 0 (10 GE commands, 13 unique colours; without the board's anti-clone security IC on GPIO 8 / 7 it shows "SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to offical SW!-----00000000000000 73010100").

desc: Edision Picco S2 firmware v.1248 (System ID 73010100, compiled 2021-01-13) for the compact Full HD DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the single-CPU ALi M3510D / C3503D SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.

Shares the single-CPU C3503D architecture and external IR/LED sensor pins (GPIO 24 / 23) with the Ferguson Ariva 54, using a standard-layout CH455 LED driver instead of Ferguson's remapped FD650K and the Edision/Amiko 0x60xx remote key table ("necfirst" coding).
